messages:
sarah (AE): Quick escalation — NovaHealth POC has stopped progressing. Infosec put the brakes on due to data residency concerns and SSO. Procurement also flagged price uplift vs our initial quote. They want an exec-level assurance to move forward.

james (SE): Summary from the tech call: they can't route PHI outside EU region. Our hosted region is EU but their legal wants deploy in their VPC or dedicated instance. SAML metadata attached in the thread earlier.

maya (sales_engineering): We delivered the POC bundle yesterday (model + small dataset). They tried a run and got a token-rate error — looks like rate-limits hit because of continuous sampling. I recommended a dedicated Dedicated pool for deterministic throughput.

oliver (eng-privacy): @sarah can you share the exact clause their InfoSec cited? Is it residency policy or contractual prohibition on third-party processing? That changes recommended path (VPC vs on-prem).

sarah (AE): Their CISO said: "No PHI outside customer-managed infrastructure; vendor processing must be under explicit EEA-only controls." Quote from the email attached.

alex (vp-sales): Thanks. Two asks for execs: 1) quick customer-facing note committing to an EEA-only private deploy + quarterly audit; 2) approval for a temporary pricing concession for the POC (we can recover in committed Dedicated contract). Who owns each?

maya (sales_engineering): I can scope the private deployment and rough cost delta. For the POC we can offer a 30% POC discount on Dedicated for first 3 months. Need approvals from finance but it's workable.

nora (legal): We don't sign anything ad-hoc. We need to get an ARR-linked addendum or an MSA amendment clarifying data residency, subprocessors, and audit rights. I can fast-track a paper but need confirmation on deployment model and KMS/HSM expectations.

james (SE): Tech detail for the exec: if we do customer-managed VPC (Redwood Private), we need 2-3 business days for provisioning, plus a runbook for network & firewall rules. On-prem will add 4-6 weeks.

sarah (AE): Customer timeline: they want POC results this quarter. If we take >2 weeks it's a competitive risk. CISO asked for a call with our CTO or Head of Security tomorrow.

oliver (eng-privacy): I can join that call. Also we should offer a SOC2 + Data Processing Addendum + on-demand audit clause. That may soothe them.

alex (vp-sales): Action plan: 1) I will send a short exec note to NovaHealth CISO committing to EEA-only private deployment for the POC and proposing a follow-up call today/tomorrow. 2) @nora prepare a concise amendment template we can sign quickly. 3) @maya produce a one-page cost/time tradeoff (VPC vs on-prem). 4) @james create the provisioning checklist.

nora (legal): I'll prepare the amendment and mark urgent — please DM me the CISO email and the exact contractual ask.

maya (sales_engineering): Draft timeline: VPC private (Redwood Private in their VPC) — provisioning 48–72h, test 24h, run POC 1 week. On-prem — 4–6 weeks as James said. Pricing delta: ~+45% ops premium for private POC but we can apply a 30% introductory discount for 3 months.

james (SE): Provisioning checklist (high level):
```
- VPC peering / transit config
- Firewall: allow outbound to management 52.23.0.0/16 (example)
- SAML metadata exchange
- KMS access (customer-managed or our HSM)
- Monitoring endpoints + log forwarding
```

sarah (AE): Can someone from execs ping their CISO? Asking for a short note from @alex or our Head of Security for credibility.

alex (vp-sales): I'll send a short email now and propose slot for a call. Wording: "We can run your POC in EEA-only, in a customer-managed VPC, with auditability and KMS controls. Redwood leadership will join a call to confirm." Will forward copy into this thread.

cal-bot: Meeting created — "NovaHealth POC: Security sync" Thu 10:00 AM CET. Invites sent to sarah, maya, oliver, james, nora, alex. :calendar: 

sarah (AE): Thanks — please also escalate to finance for the temporary concession approval. @finance on call?

maya (sales_engineering): I'll assemble the cost sheet and a short Ops runbook for the call.

nora (legal): Once I have the precise wording (alex), I'll route an amendment to their counsel and request a fast-track review.

oliver (eng-privacy): Prep note for the call: explain encryption-at-rest keys (customer KMS option), log retention window, and that no model weights or temp caches will be egressed outside EEA.

sarah (AE): Customer CISO replied: "If Redwood leadership signs to EEA-only and provides the audit addendum, we'll greenlight the POC start next week." This is the gating item.

alex (vp-sales): Understood. Nora + Oliver, prioritize the addendum + technical attestation. I'll loop in our Head of Security on the call.

james (SE): I'll stand by for provisioning access and will pre-stage images to shave >=24h from setup.

sarah (AE): Closing note: please post final email copy here before sending so I can align with customer thread. :eyes:

alex (vp-sales): Draft sent to thread — short, firm, and includes our commitments. Waiting on legal + privacy attachments.

nora (legal): Amendment drafted, ready to attach. Sending to alex for sign-off.

sarah (AE): Customer replied on the thread: "Thanks — we can target next Monday for POC kickoff once amendment signed." Positive.

alex (vp-sales): Great. Keep this thread updated with when amendment is signed and when provisioning creds are ready.

sarah (AE): Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
